messages:
ida: Quick triage request - Helio POC rotated keys and now seeing mix of 401 and 429 on staging canaries. Hits started ~13:05 UTC. Need swarming.

kevin: 401s + 429s together usually mean some requests rejected at auth while others hit rate limits. can you paste the curl and response headers?

ida: customer pasted a minimal repro: `curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_helio_new\" -d '{\"input\":\"ping\"}'` -> sometimes `HTTP/1.1 401 \n{\"error\":\"unauthorized\",\"message\":\"invalid signer\"}` other times `HTTP/1.1 429 \n{\"error\":\"rate_limited\",\"message\":\"too many concurrent requests\"}`. No request-id in body.

sophia: looked up the token id in key service: sk_helio_new was issued during a migration and uses new signer version `v2-ecdsa` while their old tokens were `v1-hmac`. Our auth layer treats mismatched signer metadata as invalid_signer -> 401. that explains the invalid signer errors.

infra-bot: automated: key-creation detected id=sk_helio_new signer=v2-ecdsa created_by=ida@redwood at 2026-03-21T13:03:10Z.

kevin: why are some requests hitting 429 then? are they replaying older keys or hitting different endpoints?

sophia: two contributing factors: 1) client fleet retries on 401s causing bursts, and 2) canary script concurrently triggering many short-lived requests which hit default rate limit for trial accounts (50 rps). the retry storms push them over the limit.

ida: customer says their deployment auto-rolls keys and a small percentage of pods still had the old signer cached causing mixed responses. they're running 20 parallel canary workers.

kevin: short-term mitigation: 1) ask them to pause canaries and redeploy pods so all use new key, 2) issue a temporary dual-signer service key that accepts both v1-hmac and v2-ecdsa for the POC, TTL 24h, and 3) increase rate limit for the POC window or advise backoff. which do we prefer?

sophia: security prefers avoid broadening production keys. recommend creating a new temporary service key that lists `accepted_signers:[\"v1-hmac\",\"v2-ecdsa\"]` (internal only) with strict scopes and TTL 24h. also reduce default retry backoff guidance to avoid bursts.

sec-bot: automated: temp-key-request queued id=req-3402 requested_by=ida@redwood reason=\"poc-helio dual-signer\". must include audit note and TTL.

ae-jordan: customer also asked about pricing if they need Dedicated for consistent throughput and to avoid rate limits during POC. they want to know about burst capacity and overage.

ida: forwarded to AE for quote but need a quick answer for presales: can we temporarily bump rate limits for a POC and what's cost implication?

kevin: ops can grant a temporary rate-limit bump for 72h for POC customers; for billing we either: 1) include bumped baseline in a short-term Dedicated trial add-on priced pro-rata, or 2) treat overage as metered billing under standard usage pricing. AE should confirm which billing flow they prefer. Quick presales answer: yes, we can support short-term uplift; formal quote needed.

sophia: created the temp service key `sk_poc_helio_dual` with accepted_signers=[\"v1-hmac\",\"v2-ecdsa\"] scopes=[\"generate:basic\",\"embed:read\"] allowed_orgs=[\"helio\"] ttl=24h. delivered via secure channel.

infra-bot: automated: service-key-created id=sk_poc_helio_dual created_by=sophia@redwood ttl=24h note=\"poc helio dual-signer\".

ida: asked customer to pause canaries, redeploy, and test with new key. shared example curl that includes `x-rw-project` and `x-rw-org`.

customer (via ida): tested and reported 200 + request_id=7f4c21 for embeds; canaries still occasionally hit 429 but much less. they will implement exponential backoff on retries.

sec-bot: automated: questionnaire flag from helio wider SQA asking: \"do you support multiple signer algorithms for key rotation?\"

sophia: reply for SQA: yes - keys have signer metadata and we support v1-hmac and v2-ecdsa during migration windows; recommend short-lived dual-accept keys for rollouts and rotate to a single signer asap. note that dual-accept keys are temporary and audited. include snippet: `key.accepted_signers = [\"v1-hmac\",\"v2-ecdsa\"] ttl=24h audit:true`.

ae-jordan: i'll follow up with formal Dedicated trial pricing and options for burst capacity (reserved pool + short-term uplift). also include overage policy for POCs.

ida: customer asked about safe cleanup - we'll revoke the temp dual key after POC + confirm all pods use the new signer. also remind them to avoid embedding keys in client-side apps.

kevin: schedule auto-revoke for sk_poc_helio_dual in 24h and add audit entry. mark support ticket `poc-helio-signer-swarm` for handoff to AE once pricing confirmed.

ida: thanks team, happy path mostly restored. closing once revoke scheduled. :thumbsup:
